title: KOMPAS GCS: Safety-gated ground control station and protocol-level simulator for commodity WiFi drones
description: KOMPAS is an open-source Python ground control station (GCS) for low-cost WiFi quadrotors that use a Tello-SDK-style text protocol over UDP. It adds what these aircraft lack: a serialised command link with an out-of-band emergency stop, a pre-flight gate of eight checks (including a live command-link probe) that blocks takeoff on any failure, and an in-flight safety monitor whose automatic actions may only land the aircraft, never cut its motors. A built-in simulator speaks the same wire protocol as the aircraft, with fault injection for link loss, one-way links, low battery and tilted ground, so the full GCS can be run and tested without hardware.
